inputs: SHA-pinned checked n51 slice and unit-layout scan
outputs: Build, rebase, and independent checker transcripts; rebased output bytes and SHA-256; terminal result.

arms.description: Retain 44,485 reverse-safe literal units and solve the remaining 1,130 coordinates by projected reverse elimination.
Reconstruct the named trace slice and check C0-C3 on rebased output.

claims.text: The selective rebase preserves the input map kernel and yields an importable D4 map only if its native triangular self-check and independent affine-slice C0-C3 checker accept.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic transformation, no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Wrong source SHA is a deterministic refusal condition; no statistical null population applies.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic small unsafe-unit and missing-unit kernel fixtures are software controls, not a positive population arm.

decision_rule.text: Only independent C0-C3 checker acceptance of the rebased output makes it a usable D4 seed; native output alone is unchecked.
decision_rule.threshold: valid_affine_slice_nonmembership with the pinned source and plan hashes

placement.checkpoint_detail: One build, one rebase, one checker; no checkpoint or automatic retry. Preserve failure output.

inadmissible: Inferring a D5 bound from a D4 rebase.
Calling native rebase output accepted before the independent checker.
Treating a killed or failed transformation as a theorem about W5.
Retrying the frozen one-attempt run without a new protocol.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

literature.claim: Trace projection and C0-C3 independent check are defined in the affine slice dossier.

primary.definition: Codimension of the rebased map only if the independent checker accepts C0-C3.
primary.name: independently checked rebased D4 codimension

question: Can the accepted n51 sliced D4 map be rebased into native unit-triangular coordinates and independently reaccepted at D4?

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

instance_sampling.rule: One fixed accepted n51 sliced D4 map; no sampling or population inference.

seed_derivation.note: Original named n51 input seed; no new random inputs.

graphs: One-row proof dependency diagram and exact stage outcome table.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Hard 300-second build, 1800-second rebase and 3600-second checker caps; not a timing claim.

stopping_rules.rule: One named n51 sliced seed, one native selective rebase, one independent checker. Stop on accepted output, refusal, timeout, or resource failure; no retry.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact kernel and certificate checks, no performance comparison.

comparisons.threshold: Independent checker accepts C0-C3 on the rebased output.
